hook_text: Build one more and watch what you add
clip_script:
Get some matchsticks, or imagine them. Make one square: four sticks. Now make a second square right next to it, sharing a side. How many sticks did you add? Not four — three, because the shared side is already there. Seven sticks for two squares. A third square: three more, ten. A fourth: thirteen. Write the numbers down: four, seven, ten, thirteen. Look at the gaps: three, three, three. Every square you add costs three sticks, and now you can see why, because you built it.

This is the whole secret of patterns. If you can see what gets added each time, you can extend the pattern forever without guessing. Five squares: sixteen. Six: nineteen. Ten squares? Start at four and add three nine more times — that is twenty-seven more — thirty-one sticks.
visual_style: Matchstick squares appearing one by one with the new sticks highlighted; a table filling in beside them
pacing: unhurried, one beat per added square
call_to_action: Open the full session to investigate any pattern in three moves.
